newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES SEEN DOWN AFTER SIX-SESSION SURGE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES SEEN DOWN AFTER SIX-SESSION SURGE.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall in profit-taking on Tuesday after their six-session 14.5-percent surge fuelled by foreign buying.
Analysts said Monday's stronger selling after price fixing and at continuous trade signalled the Tuesday fall but said it was not yet clear how deep the correction would be.
Paintmaker Polifarb Debica starts trade on the parallel market on Tuesday.
